Quick Answer for Sourcing

  • Confirm dieline and artwork requirements.
  • Request lead time for production and shipping.
  • Validate barrier properties (for flexible packaging).

Print and color verification method

Method for Strengthening One-Stop Solutions for Boxes, Bags & Labels: Record the approved physical reference, substrate, ink and print process, finish, viewing condition, instrument geometry, illuminant and observer, color-difference formula, measurement locations and acceptance limit.

  • ISO 3664:2025 specifies viewing conditions for critical comparison of prints and reference objects.
  • International Color Consortium Profile Registry links registered profiles to standard printing conditions and public characterization data sets.

Evidence limit: A color value without the formula, instrument conditions, substrate and reference is incomplete. Final approval should use the agreed proof or physical sample and a project-specific measurement record. Procurement FAQ — Strengthening One-Stop Solutions for Boxes, Bags & Labels

What is the MOQ for Strengthening One-Stop Solutions for Boxes, Bags & Labels?

Our standard minimum order quantity (MOQ) for custom projects is 500 PCS. We support small brands with factory-direct pricing.

Do you provide free dielines?

Yes! Once you provide dimensions, our engineering team sends a free dieline template within 24 hours.

How long is the production time?

Bulk production is usually completed within 20-30 days after final sample approval.

Do you support global shipping?

Yes, we ship worldwide from China via sea, air, and express courier (DHL/FedEx).

Can I get a sample first?

Yes. We offer digital proofing for free and physical pre-production samples for a small fee.
